item.title: Pasteory 0.1.31
item.description:
# Pasteory 0.1.31 Beta
- English is now the default on first launch. Switch instantly between English and Simplified Chinese in Settings → General → Interface Language; your choice is remembered. - The Quick Panel, Library, Settings, menus, dialogs, update prompts, and Chrome extension popup support both languages. Clipboard content, titles, notes, and custom groups keep their original text. - The English README now focuses on everyday use, links to a Chinese version, and includes new Quick Panel and Library screenshots in both languages. - The Library lives in a larger, resizable Settings window. ⌘L opens the Library; ⌘, opens General. - Daily update checks and an independently colored Update ↓ button let you review release notes before confirming a GitHub download, verification, installation, and restart.
This Beta is built in Release configuration and uses a local development code signature generated on macOS. It is not signed with an Apple Developer ID certificate and is not notarized.
If direct paste stops working after upgrading an older locally signed build, re-enable Pasteory in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
Requires macOS 14 or later and Apple Silicon. Versions 0.1.29 and earlier need one manual installation to gain the updater.
---
- 首次启动默认英文，可在“设置 → 通用 → 界面语言”即时切换简体中文 / English，并记住选择。 - 快捷面板、资料库、设置、菜单、弹窗、更新提示和 Chrome 插件弹窗均支持两种语言。剪贴板内容、标题、备注和自定义分组保留原文。 - README 默认英文并提供中文入口，补充两种语言的快捷面板和资料库截图，专注日常使用。 - 资料库位于更大的可缩放设置窗口，⌘L 定位资料库，⌘, 打开通用设置。 - 每日检查更新，发现新版时显示独立配色的“更新 ↓”，查看说明并确认后才从 GitHub 下载、校验、安装和重启。
此 Beta 使用 Release 编译配置及 macOS 本地生成的开发代码签名；未使用 Apple Developer ID 证书，也未经过 Apple 公证。
从旧的本地签名版本升级后，如果直接粘贴失效，请在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 辅助功能”中重新允许 Pasteory。
需要 macOS 14 或更高版本及 Apple Silicon。0.1.29 及更早版本需先手动安装一次，才具备应用内更新能力。
